translation.title: Loxoprofen Sodium Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for lower back pain, shoulder pain from stiff shoulders, joint pain, muscle pain, tenosynovitis (hand and wrist pain), elbow pain (such as tennis elbow), bruises and sprains.
translation.usage: Depending on your symptoms, apply an appropriate amount to the affected area 3 to 4 times a day and rub it in gently so that it is absorbed well. Do not use it continuously for more than 2 weeks.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have or have had asthma related to aspirin or other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, or for children under 15, and do not use it in the eyes or on mucous membranes, on areas where the skin is delicate (such as the face or armpits), or on areas with eczema, inflammation, athlete's foot, insect bites, pus or wounds. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or if you are elderly. Do not use an occlusive (airtight) dressing without a doctor's supervision. Do not exceed about 2 g per application and 50 g per week. If your symptoms do not improve after about 5 to 6 days of use, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Be careful not to get it in your eyes; if it does get in, rinse immediately with lukewarm water, and see a doctor if symptoms are severe. For external use only. Wash your hands after use. Do not use it together with other topical analgesic anti-inflammatory medicines. Adverse reactions may occur - shock-like symptoms (hives, swelling and chest tightness together with a pale face, cold hands and feet, cold sweat and difficulty breathing), rash, redness, itching, swelling, stinging, inflammation and blisters, pigmentation, stomach discomfort, upper abdominal pain, diarrhea, loose stools and edema; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
